svg.title: A* expanding across a grid maze
svg.desc: An illustrative 12 by 12 grid maze with walls. A* starts at S at the bottom left and expands 59 of 87 drivable nodes, always taking the lowest cost plus Manhattan distance to the goal, until it reaches G at the top right. The route found is 25 moves long.

g.text: A* searching a 12 by 12 grid of nodes
not the one used in the paper.
